It is a quest reward for [[Final Round: Fight!]] ==Acquisition== ;[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]] *[[Gunnar's Hold]] **[[Final Round: Fight!]] ==Stats== :[[Energy]] +6 :[[Inscription]]: "Hail to the King" :[[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (while Health is above 50%) :Energy +6 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) :Energy +6 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]]) :Energy +6 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]]) :Energy +6 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]]) :Energy +6 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]]) :[[Health]] +30 ==Replica== Except for the visual appearance and the variable requirements for energy, it is possible to create a replica of this focus with the same stats. Create a replica with the following: *One of the following foci with the appropriate attribute: **[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]] **[[Imperial Focus]] from [[collector]] [[Shen Xi]] **[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]] **[[Divine Favor]]: [[Divine Symbol]] from collector [[Jwup]] **[[Energy Storage]]: [[Golden Chalice]] from collector [[Kilgor Rageheart]] **[[Fast Casting]]: [[Gilded Artifact]] from collector [[Ivarr Stewbrewer]] **[[Soul Reaping]]: [[Bone Idol]] from collector [[Danira]] **[[Spawning Power]]: [[Ceremonial Cauldron]] from collector [[Ivarr Stewbrewer]] *[[Perfect]] [["Hail to the King"]] [[inscription]] OR *One of the following foci with the appropriate attribute: **[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]] **[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] **[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]] **Focus from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]] *Perfect [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]] *Perfect "Hail to the King" inscription ==Dye== This item cannot be [[dye]]d. ==Notes== * Although this is a [[rarity|"gold"]] item, the inscription can't be replaced; the cup can't be [[salvage]]d, dyed or even sold to a [[merchant]]. * [[Zehtuka's Horn]] has nearly identical stats as this item; however, it reduces physical damage instead of increasing armor. * [[Beacon of the Unseen]] has nearly identical stats as this item; however, it requires [[Channeling Magic]].
